newsitem.title: USA: Pulitzer December revenues off 0.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Pulitzer December revenues off 0.3 pct.

text.p: Pulitzer Publishing Inc said Wednesday its revenues for the four weeks ended December 29 decreased 0.03 percent compared with the five weeks ended December 31, 1995.
The publishing and broadcasting company said revenues were $44.5 million compared with $44.7 million a year ago. Year to date, revenues advanced 13.1 percent to $534.1 million from $472.3 milion.
The 1996 data includes revenues of Scripps League Newspapers Inc (renamed Pulitzer Community Newspapers Inc), which Pulitzer acquired on July 1, 1996.
Pulitzer Community Newspapers added $5,708 in December revenues and $34,855 to year-to-date revenues.
